source: scorecard CLI (--format=json --show-details), run per repository in this workflow

documentation.short: Determines if the project runs tests before pull requests are merged.
Determines if the project requires human code review before pull requests (aka merge requests) are merged.
Determines if the project cryptographically signs release artifacts.
Determines if the project's GitHub Action workflows avoid dangerous patterns.
Determines if the project's workflows follow the principle of least privilege.
Determines if the default and release branches are protected with GitHub's branch protection settings.
Determines if the project uses fuzzing. Applies only to repositories with more than 5% code in a non-memory-safe language (C, C++, Objective-C, assembly); all others are not applicable.
